function: DRL jointly learns task offloading (CDC parameters, vehicle selection) and the radar/communication power split of a DFRC vehicle; excluded as system: single-antenna link without RIS (p. 5).
notes: Reason system, the first code that applies. The DQN-Regu and DDQN-Regu action (eq. 18, p. 7) includes, with the offloading decisions, "iv) the power fraction μ between the radar and communication functions" (p. 7), a resource that serves sensing and communication (area 5), so above_phy and function do not apply. The link is single-antenna without RIS: the rate of eq. (3), p. 5, has only scalar antenna gains and "hn is the channel gain between the task vehicle and service vehicle n"; Table II, p. 11, gives scalar gains Gtx,rad = Grx,rad = 1.8, and the paper has no antenna array, beamformer, or RIS. If the reviewer does not count the radar/communication power split as a physical-layer decision, the reason becomes above_phy, since the other learned decisions are task partition, service vehicle selection, and output selection (p. 7).
